context: The seminar closes with a reflective wrap-up
purpose: Summarize learnings; teach 語る/挙げ/現れ/間違っ/許さ/それとも

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 最後に、学んだことを語る形でまとめましょう。
lines.en: Finally, let us wrap up by speaking what we learned.
lines.style: guiding teacher closing the session, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 具体例を一つ挙げます。
lines.en: I will give one concrete example.
lines.style: confident student volunteering first, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 私も例を挙げていいですか？
lines.en: May I give an example too?
lines.style: newly emboldened teen joining in, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: どうぞ。新しい考えが現れる瞬間ですね。
lines.en: Go ahead. This is the moment new ideas appear.
lines.style: delighted teacher welcoming her growth, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 自分が間違っていたと気づきました。
lines.en: I realized I had been mistaken.
lines.style: humble student admitting his error, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 間違っても許される場って大切ですね。
lines.en: A place where mistakes are forgiven is precious.
lines.style: reflective teen valuing the safe space

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: そうです。誰も君を許さないわけじゃない。
lines.en: Right. It is not that no one will forgive you.
lines.style: warm teacher offering final reassurance, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 続ける、それとも休む、自分で決めます。
lines.en: Continue, or rest, I will decide myself.
lines.style: self-assured student owning his path, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 「それとも」と問う心を忘れず、語る人でいてください。
lines.en: Keep the questioning heart and stay someone who speaks out.
lines.style: inspiring teacher leaving a parting message
